data.name: Binance Alpha
data.title: Binance Alpha
data.description: The Binance Alpha category tracks early-stage tokens selected and spotlighted by Binance for potential listing or airdrop consideration, often featuring high-growth emerging projects on BNB Chain and beyond.

data.name: Memes
data.title: Memes
data.description: The Memes category encompasses tokens created around internet culture, jokes, or viral trends, typically with no formal utility but driven largely by community enthusiasm and speculative trading.

data.name: Solana Ecosystem
data.title: Solana Ecosystem
data.description: The Solana Ecosystem category covers tokens and protocols built on the Solana blockchain, a high-throughput, low-fee Layer 1 network known for its speed and growing DeFi and NFT activity.

data.name: AI Memes
data.title: AI Memes
data.description: The AI Memes category groups meme tokens that combine artificial intelligence themes with internet culture, often launched around AI hype cycles and driven by speculative community interest.

data.name: Terminal of Truths
data.title: Terminal of Truths
data.description: The Terminal of Truths category groups tokens associated with the AI persona "Terminal of Truths," an autonomous AI agent that gained viral attention and inspired a cluster of related meme tokens.

data.name: Pump Fun Ecosystem
data.title: Pump Fun Ecosystem
data.description: The Pump Fun Ecosystem category includes tokens launched on Pump.fun, a viral meme token launchpad on Solana that enables anyone to create and trade tokens instantly with a built-in bonding curve mechanism.

data.name: Binance Ecosystem
data.title: Binance Ecosystem
data.description: The Binance Ecosystem category broadly covers all tokens and projects within the Binance universe, including BNB Chain projects, Binance-listed assets, and ventures backed or operated by the Binance organization.

data.name: Base Ecosystem
data.title: Base Ecosystem
data.description: The Base Ecosystem category covers tokens and protocols built on Base, Coinbase's Ethereum Layer 2 network built on the OP Stack, known for its rapid user growth and consumer-focused dApps.

data.name: BNB Chain Ecosystem
data.title: Top BNB Chain Tokens by Market Capitalization
data.description: The BNB Chain Ecosystem category includes tokens and dApps built on BNB Chain (formerly Binance Smart Chain), Binance's EVM-compatible blockchain offering fast transactions and a broad DeFi ecosystem.

data.name: Four.Meme Ecosystem
data.title: Four.Meme Ecosystem
data.description: The Four.Meme Ecosystem category tracks tokens launched on Four.Meme, a meme token launchpad on BNB Chain that enables permissionless token creation and community-driven trading.
